layers.counts: every shot attempt the league recorded: on goal, missed, or blocked, because all three are the team moving the puck at the net
layers.credits: A blocked attempt is credited to the club that shot it — the shot was still taken, it just never arrived.
layers.label: ＋ Control (Corsi)

layers.counts: attempts from within 33 ft of the net, between the face-off dots
layers.credits: Credited to the club that shot. Blocked attempts are excluded because the coordinate the feed records is where the puck stopped — so we know who shot it, but not from where.
layers.label: ＋ Shots from the slot

work.label: How many shot attempts are taken from the slot

layers.counts: the attempts a body stopped before they reached the goalie
layers.credits: Each block is credited to the club that made it, the way a broadcast does. A block by a teammate is credited to neither, so the two figures need not add up.
layers.label: ＋ Blocked shots

layers.counts: every shot each goaltender faced, and what became of it — saved, scored on, or missed the net
layers.credits: Each goaltender is counted for the club he plays for, against the other club’s shots — so these two columns read the opposite way round.
layers.label: ＋ Goaltending

work.label: How often a goaltender makes the save

layers.counts: the rule that stopped play, and the dot it restarted on
layers.credits: A stoppage names a rule and never a club, so nothing here is credited to either side.
layers.label: ＋ Why play stopped

work.label: How many penalties a team takes
How often a team is offside
How often a team ices the puck

layers.counts: every faceoff, and for the club that won it, whether that draw was in its offensive zone, the neutral zone, or its defensive zone
layers.credits: Each draw is credited to the club that won it, in the zone that club was attacking toward — so the same dot is an offensive-zone start for one club and a defensive-zone start for the other. The league records the winner and not the loser, so a draw has one club and never two.
layers.label: ＋ Zone starts

work.label: What a face-off in one end is worth
